claim: Useful native dashboard data was qualified on the current host: existing memory pages/search, semantic code retrieval and generated graph, scoped lexical retrieval, selected native session imports, unchanged Promptfoo fixture HTML, and a populated Grafana home. A naturally triggered native timer published actual metadata to Loki; independent reconciliation matched seven separate savings scopes, three memory inventories and 68 dated coverage records.
limitations: Current-host native command/API/browser integration acceptance, not the upstream projects' full test suites, exhaustive landscape saturation, physical reboot or another-PC acceptance.

The Grafana panels, metadata adapter, token report and offline guards are local integration code. Component memory, graph, archive and evaluation views are their upstream interfaces or unchanged generated artifacts.

Native token estimates overlap and use different formulas/windows. Context Mode retained events and session bytes are different bases. Desktop retained counters are stale; causal provider savings and universal per-repository lifetime savings remain unknown.

ai-memory CLI counters are database-wide; project scope is established separately by native UI/MCP retrieval. QMD intentionally uses BM25 with zero vectors. Qdrant points must not be counted again as dense plus sparse vectors.
AgentsView contains explicitly imported snapshots of one Codex and two Claude sessions, not continuous ingestion. SocratiCode graph HTML is an explicit snapshot, not a continuously regenerated graph.

Promptfoo imported and exported two existing passing local echo assertions. No new evaluation or provider/model-quality measurement was made. The initial version inspection timed out; its default-profile byte preservation was not measured.

Serena's future launch configuration is corrected, but existing MCP processes cannot hot-enable its dashboard. Normal MCP/client reload is required; no current Serena dashboard or forced restart is claimed.

Raw native streams and private configurations remain local. Public artifacts are labeled metadata projections or exact safe native outputs, with original byte/hash bindings. Exit codes for some earlier service/archive commands are coordinator tool observations.

Independent review found and resolved malformed receipt metadata handling. Failed-source supersession is covered by local offline guards; a failed live generation was not injected. Reviewer agreement alone is not acceptance evidence.

ai_memory.change: Only append --enable-web to the active existing service override

socraticode_cli.repair: Only SocratiCode MCPorter lifecycle=ephemeral, SOCRATICODE_WATCHER=off, SOCRATICODE_AUTO_RESUME=off; other entries preserved

memory_and_retrieval.inference_boundary: Actual SocratiCode queries used the existing local embedding model. No external provider completion was requested in this dashboard wave.

command_provenance: Commands with placeholders are portable templates. Exact selected argv, cwd, timestamps, native outputs and errors remain in private records; public projections normalize paths and bind original bytes. Native read-only GET endpoints and returned statuses appear in the artifacts.

archive.observation: Native API and SQLite metadata independently reconciled; imported active files can advance after capture

observation.mechanism: Native Grafana provisioning and default_home_dashboard_path; private metadata adapter uses native Loki JSON ingestion
observation.timer_scope: Selected metadata reads only; no inference, full ledger refresh, session import, research or orders
observation.browser_boundary: Native browser rendered populated panels and original-audit/canonical-receipt columns. Broad error-substring selection also matches the upstream error-reason metric legend, so alerts and returned query data were inspected instead.

savings_at_retained_capture.measurement: Native estimates only; scopes overlap and are not additive
savings_at_retained_capture.context_formula: Retained event count x 256; session kept-out bytes / 4. Different bases.
savings_at_retained_capture.zero_boundary: Zero is a returned counter, not proof that the tool is ineffective or that all sessions are covered.

other_existing_views.dagu: Run history has one observed successful equity research run; five bundled examples are not executions
other_existing_views.ntfy: Configured ecosystem-alerts topic had 20 retained messages
other_existing_views.omniroute: Native 30-day usage API returned 31 requests and 57,720 tokens; compression counter is separate and zero. No new traffic was created to populate it.

validation.independent_review: Source, private-stream hash bindings, native values, deployed helper, Loki rows, Grafana provisioning and natural timer activation checked read-only. One supported malformed-metadata finding fixed and rechecked.
